title: The death of Zou Shaomeng, the 124th Division's chief of staff
reading: Shot outside the north gate at about 18:30 on the 17th
basis: Both sides put it at the north gate; the report places it after the 3rd Battalion reached the north-west corner at 18:30 and gives no time of its own.

records.says: 百二十四師参謀長鄒紹孟
records.label: a mounted officer with some fifty guards, shot leaving by the north gate on the evening of the 17th and identified from his papers

records.says: killed near the north gate on 17 March
records.label: the Chinese accounts
